## 🧰 Key Data Points & Attributes to Capture (for each prospect)

These are “columns” in your CRM / Apollo profile that help you qualify and segment.

| Attribute | Why It Matters / Use Case |
|---|---|
| Company / business name | Identity + lookup reference |
| Industry niche / vertical | Helps tailor messaging (fabrication, mining, energy, agriculture, etc.) |
| Location(s) / service territory | Important for logistics, delivery, servicing |
| Years in business / establishment date | Indicates maturity / stability |
| Number of employees / shop floor staff | Size gauge |
| Annual revenue or revenue range | Ability to afford equipment / financing |
| Types of machinery or equipment they currently have | To see upsell / cross-sell potential |
| Whether they buy, lease, or rent equipment | Determines financing / selling approach |
| Current challenges (capital constraints, maintenance, downtime, sourcing parts) | Useful for positioning solution |
| Key decision-maker(s) / titles | Who to contact (Operations, Maintenance, Owner, Purchasing) |
| Email / direct contact / phone / LinkedIn | Means to reach them |
| Do they own their facility / land / building? | CapEx vs rental affects their buying flexibility |
| Do they outsource maintenance / repairs or do in-house? | Could be another pain point or revenue stream |
| Do they maintain an inventory of spare parts / stock? | Indicates their operational maturity |
| Any upcoming expansion, machinery refresh, facility upgrade plans | Indicates buying intent / timing |
| Financing / leasing providers used (or open to) | Helps structure offers |
| Equipment insurance / warranty practices | Risk tolerance, future services |
| Secondary operations (e.g. custom fabrication, servicing, parts resale) | Additional revenue streams & needs |
| Online presence (website, social, reviews) | Helps get extra insight / validate credibility |
| Whether they attend trade shows / industrial expos | They’re more growth-oriented / invest in staying current |
| Memberships / associations (industry orgs, trade groups) | Networking, trust signals |
| Local competition / nearby shops | For territory analysis, pricing & positioning |
| Any regulatory / compliance requirements specific to their industry | Could be a barrier or value point |

## ❓ Questions to Ask (or Research) During Discovery or Prospecting

Use these either during conversation, in your intake survey, or via secondary research.

1. Which types of machinery or equipment are you currently using (brand / models)?  
2. How old is your current machinery lineup / What is the average age?  
3. Do you have plans to **replace** or **expand** equipment in the next 12–24 months?  
4. Do you prefer to **buy outright**, **lease**, or **rent / lease-to-own** equipment?  
5. What is your typical budget or capital allocation for machinery procurement?  
6. What are your biggest challenges right now? (Downtime, sourcing parts, machine breakdowns, capacity constraints, etc.)  
7. Do you have an in-house maintenance / engineering team, or do you outsource it?  
8. How would you describe your decision-making process / who signs off on equipment purchases?  
9. Do you already use financing or leasing partners? If so, which ones?  
10. What is your expected ROI / payback period threshold when buying new equipment?  
11. What does your ideal vendor or partner look like? (service, warranty, support, delivery, parts, etc.)  
12. How important is after-sales support, spares inventory, and service response time to you?  
13. Do you track metrics like machine uptime, OEE (overall equipment efficiency), maintenance cost, etc.?  
14. Are there regulatory, safety, or compliance constraints you must meet when installing new equipment?  
15. Do you have space / infrastructure (power, layout) ready for adding new machinery?  
16. Who is involved in vendor evaluation (engineering, operations, procurement, finance)?  
17. Do you attend trade shows or sourcing events?  
18. Have you purchased used or reconditioned machines before? Why or why not?  
19. What concerns / fears do you have when buying machinery? (delivery, installation, calibration, warranties, parts)  
20. What would make you switch from your current supplier / vendor?
